title: 닥터X 계수정, 정체 숨기는 이유는? 손현주가 던진 질문
source: 11/6(금) 09:00 네이버 원고 — 방영 중 드라마 글 시험 1편 (사용자 확인용), 홈판형
note: 6장 = 대표사진(김지원 위키미디어 사진) 1 + SBS 공식 장면 사진 인용 2 + 정보 카드 2 + 장면 1. 장면 사진은 PC 가 SBS 포토갤러리에서 받는다(못 받으면 사람 없는 AI 그림)

images.title: 김지원 단독 사진 (대표사진)
images.prompt: Camera and composition: top-down flat lay view of a table with three to five related objects neatly arranged, no people. Keep the top fifth of the image as softly blurred or plain background (a title band goes there). A surgeon's folded green scrub cap and a stethoscope on a steel tray in a dim operating room. Color theme: warm burgundy and cream tones with a soft gold accent. Natural realistic photograph look, soft light, shallow depth of field, real Korean places, natural colors, clean composition. Show only what is described above as the main subject; do not add other large objects that are not described. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, labels, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere. Do not depict any real or famous person; every face is an ordinary fictional person.
